name: mailbend
description: Use an installed MailBend server with its mail skill and optional send/delete prompt.

mailbend_dir.title: MailBend installation
mailbend_dir.description: Absolute path to a built MailBend installation containing scripts/mailbend and bin/.

email.title: Primary account address
email.description: Primary email address used to log in to your mail provider, not an alias.

password_file.title: App-password file
password_file.description: Absolute path to your private, user-owned 0600 password file. Enter a path, never a password.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Keep 1 to refuse all mail changes and attachment downloads. Choose 0 only to enable writes deliberately.

drafts_only.title: Drafts-only mode
drafts_only.description: Keep 1 to refuse sending even after read-only mode is disabled. This does not block deletion or other writes.
